Sword & Shield series · CRZ

Crown Zenith

Released January 20, 2023 · 160 cards

StandardExpanded

Crown Zenith is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Sword & Shield series, released in English on January 20, 2023. Its main set has 159 cards, plus 1 secret rare numbered beyond the set (160 in total). It includes 123 Pokémon, 29 Trainer and 8 Energy cards, and is legal in the Standard and Expanded formats.

Illustrators

83 illustrators worked on Crown Zenith. Most cards: 5ban Graphics (11), PLANETA Mochizuki (8), Amelicart (4), KIYOTAKA OSHIYAMA (3), kodama (3), Kouki Saitou (3), Mina Nakai (3), Nisota Niso (3).
